impact.affected_asset: Victim workstation executing a Gravity/Telekube installation or join script.
impact.attacker_capability: Cause a victim who follows an attacker-provided, vendor-hosted installation URL and pipes its response to Bash to execute a command embedded through the URL path.
impact.security_effect: Attacker-controlled system command execution on a victim workstation that executes the generated script.

causal_trace.summary: An unauthenticated requester supplies a URL-path version or server-profile value containing URL-encoded shell command substitution.
User-controlled version numbers or server roles are inserted into generated Bash-script templates without sanitization, so input intended as data can be interpreted as shell syntax.

The join-instruction template places serverProfile in the unquoted --role={{.profile}} command position; when a victim pipes the generated installer script to Bash, Bash evaluates injected command substitution.
The report states that piping the resulting script to Bash executes the injected system command on the victim workstation; its example observable is creation of grav via $(touch grav).

failure.operation: Bash command-substitution evaluation in a victim-executed generated installer or join script

primary_invariant.statement: Values derived from installer URL paths or server-role inputs must remain data when rendered into Bash scripts and must not be parsed by Bash as syntax.
primary_invariant.violated_because: The audited implementation rendered serverProfile into an unquoted Bash command argument, and the report identifies version and server-role values as unsanitized template inputs.

provenance.source_id: Doyensec Gravitational Gravity Q2 2019 Finding 1: Install Scripts Command Injection

quality.review_notes: The primary audit provides two unauthenticated request shapes, payloads, victim precondition, claimed execution effect, and remediation. The pinned source page corroborates unquoted serverProfile template interpolation. No captured HTTP response, execution transcript, fix diff, or independently verified current-version status is bundled; the oracle is a report-derived contract rather than an observed run.

remediation.invariant_restored: Version and server-role values are sanitized before insertion into Bash templates so they cannot introduce Bash syntax or command substitution.
mitigation_classes: constrain version and server-role values before rendering

affected_versions_or_commits.value: Gravity Community v6.0.0-rc.1 / 6.0.0-beta.1 scope reported by Doyensec

target.component: installer and cluster-join Bash instruction generation

oracle.channel: unauthenticated HTTP request plus inspection of the generated script
oracle.expected_negative: After input sanitization, equivalent version or server-profile inputs do not appear as executable command-substitution syntax in the generated script.
oracle.expected_positive: For the report's URL-encoded command-substitution path payload, the returned generated script contains the decoded command substitution; executing that script through Bash would produce the stated observable, such as creation of grav or a sleep-induced delay.
